name: Maximum binary constant-weight code A(17,4,5)
definition: Find the largest set of binary words of length 17, each of Hamming weight 5, with pairwise Hamming distance at least 4.
solution_format: An object with codewords, a list of distinct 17-character binary strings.
constraints: Each codeword has Hamming weight exactly 5.
Every unordered pair of codewords has Hamming distance at least 4.
verification: The checker parses exact binary strings, checks length and weight, rejects duplicates, and verifies all unordered pairs with integer XOR bit counts.

source_review.definition: 固定A(17,4,5)，长度17、权5、任意两码字Hamming距至少4，最大化码字数。等价packing D(17,5,4)，因此T063合并重复候选，不再增加任务数。
source_review.primary_source: Sol亲读Milshtein Springer DOI10.1007/s12095-022-00611-5摘要，明确传统Generic Scuba Search的计算搜索由441改444，在线2022-10-08、卷15(2023)p443–453。Brouwer作者邮件原文件8070字节SHA bc5261c3f1b9229985dcd4a95388bf15b42f9d657aa1fa55fd017121d255216a，Sol重新下载全部444行并逐行比对human输出。2023 correction仅改公式编号和引文，没有改444构造。
source_review.independent_math: 正式checker逐对XOR bit_count。Sol另将码字映成5元子集，核对每个4元子集只出现一次，累计2220个互异4子集，独立证明任意两块交≤3从而距离≥4。另原文件98346对实测最小距4。此对应也证明与组合packing任务等价。
